implemented: Normal viewer input now stays high-depth at small resolutions; documentation distinguishes developed bounded output from raw scene-linear data.

Each captured frame carries a typed input encoding, actual ICC SHA-256, variant UUID, source extension and native adjustment revision. Draft reductions retain that description. Viewer source reuse checks the exact variant, encoding, dimensions request and native revision; export validates the copied descriptor against its captured snapshot. All 16 native frames declared the expected identity and each encoding had one distinct ICC fingerprint across cameras.

The packaged runtime passed 95 licensed RAW checks. The four cameras record their actual Capture One input profile names and ICC hashes: RicohGR3-Generic, NikonZ6-ProStandard, FujiXT4-Generic and CanonEOSR-ProStandard. The native exposure, white balance and highlights tests operate on copied variants and restore exact white balance multipliers as well as adjustment values.

At the selected Linear Rec.2020 developed output, +1 EV produced median linear-luminance gains from 1.94 to 2.58 and −1 EV produced 0.316 to 0.369. Gains varied across each image’s interior midtones, verifying that these transfer-encoded-linear pixels retain Capture One’s developed-image tone behavior. White balance moves changed channel values and highlight recovery changed thousands of bright, finite pixels without changing alpha or canvas geometry.

The exact audit.5 binaries passed 111 native RAW colour checks. Capture One’s bitmap and TIFF destinations were developed from the same captured settings for all four camera files. All 2,004,657 RGB16 channel codes were identical. Each native TIFF embedded the exact verified 664-byte Linear Rec.2020 profile.

The licensed Viewer detects input ICC replacement at idle, cancels stale work, drops derived pixels and rebuilds the source when the original profile is restored. Previously captured native development holds the profile stable while reading and rejects a changed ICC. The isolated ProPhoto fault fixture restored the original bytes and observed a fresh painted 16-bit frame in both launches. 287 first-launch, 291 restart and 115 RAW colour assertions passed on the final source.

A generated Bayer DNG with independently verified sensor samples and black/white levels exercised the native default DNG Standard and Linear Response curves at 0 and +1 EV. The exact audit.14 source delivered 16-bit Linear Rec.2020 with the same ICC in all four cases. +1 EV measured 0.21 to 1.42 stops over usable neutral patches with DNG Standard and 0.08 to 1.61 stops with Linear Response. This measures retained Capture One development with a linear transfer. Twenty-three licensed assertions passed with the isolated source file and original catalog unchanged.

The immutable source descriptor now includes input primaries, transfer, exact host build and DLL hash, variant, ICC and native revision. Renderer reuse still requires reference-identical float bytes and dimensions, with new frame upload identity for a changed source.

Eleven independent descriptor contracts cover all four encodings, identity changes, invalid shape/depth/byte count, opaque and preserved sample layouts, draft metadata and rejection of undeclared transfer. tasks.title: Admit rendering by real memory budgets across worker contexts
implemented: Measure peak worker working set and Vulkan allocation counters at 0.96, 6 and 24 MP for color and optics in packed Viewer and float export routes. Separate benchmark measured 2-sample draft synthesis and renderer-default synthesis.

Shared system RAM admission estimates and reserves physical/commit headroom for native development, worker transport, and output encoding. Verified reusable reservations and pressure in synthetic 4/6/8 GiB system headroom cases, plus an actual full 24 MP export under guard.

Query VK_EXT_memory_budget on the selected adapter where available and fall back to the conservative heap-based allocator budget. Use estimated graph bytes and reserved headroom to choose full-size tiling or refuse an infeasible frame. Grain synthesis retains the full-frame requirement.

The exact audit.15 worker completed all 16 renderer/transport cases and 80 requests at 24, 45, 61 and 100 MP on RTX 3090. Both colour-only and optical cases used packed Viewer and float image export. At 100 MP, warm p95 was 428 ms or 5.30 s in the Viewer and 2.20 s or 8.51 s for float export, from four warm requests per case. The optical export used 6.33 GiB peak worker commit and 3.09 GiB transient cache. Its 800 tiled results returned 9.38 GB of GPU readback for the 1.60 GB float reply, identifying tile overlap transfer as the main measured candidate for improvement. These timings exclude Capture One development, ICC conversion and file encoding.

The worker now chooses larger packed Viewer tiles only on images at least 4096 px in each dimension, with an existing halo no greater than 256 px and reported dynamic budget for source plus estimated scratch.
